description: List repository labels. Returns a response envelope {labels, page, limit, count, has_next, total_count}; has_next true means a further page may exist; re-issue the call with page incremented to fetch it. total_count is the server grand total, omitted when unknown. When the owner is an organization and include_org_labels is true (default), org-level labels are merged into the labels list; count includes them, while has_next and total_count describe the repository labels only. Each label carries a scope field of "repo" or "org".

include_org_labels.description: Merge org-level labels into the response when the owner is an organization. Default true.

name: list_repo_labels
